correctness.rationale: For each N>=3 a tensor-bosonic expansion of one photon per spatial input yields P_U=||sum_{sigma} a_sigma P_sigma V||^2, with determinant sum of alternating a_sigma equal det U!=0. For rank N independent internal labels make all orbit tensors independent. For rank N-1, expand the unique dependence phi_N=sum_{i in T}c_i phi_i into linearly independent repeated-label sectors: zero probability forces a_{sigma(i N)}=-a_sigma for every i in T. If |T|>=2 these transpositions force six alternating products in a nonzero 3x3 submatrix of the unitary, contradicting r_x=-r_y, r_y=-r_z, r_x=-r_z for ratios of two columns. If |T|=1, a balanced two-port HOM beamsplitter kills full coincidence. For full-support T, Gram J has exactly sign-representation kernel; projection and van der Waerden permanent inequality yield P_U>=lambda_*(J)[N!/N^N-1/N!]>0. Independent exact tensor/Gram/HOM tests check small N but the all-N statement is proved by the algebra.
residual_risks: No result for rank<=N-2, internally entangled initial sources, mixed internal states, losses or non-collision-free outputs.
Numerical N=3..5 examples are not the proof of universal nonvanishing; bound does not optimize lambda_*.
